note: expected = instrument:section keys any of which is an acceptable top hit; must_all = every key that a complete answer should cite. outcome: answer | partial | refuse (corpus does not cover it)

cases.q: how long can police keep me before taking me to court
cases.truth: Constitution s.35(4): 24 hours where a court is within 40km, otherwise 48 hours (or reasonable time per s.35(5)).

cases.q: can the police search my phone without a warrant
cases.truth: s.37 privacy of telephone conversations; Police Act search provisions; no express phone-search rule.

cases.q: what are my rights when I am arrested in Nigeria
cases.truth: Constitution s.35(2)-(3): silent, lawyer, informed in writing within 24h in language understood; ACJA s.6; Police Act s.35.

cases.q: how many years can a president stay in power
cases.truth: 4-year term (s.135), maximum two terms (s.137(3)).

cases.q: what is the minimum age to run for president
cases.truth: s.131(b): 40 years.

cases.q: minimum age to be a governor
cases.truth: s.177(b): 35 years.

cases.q: what age do you need to be to become a senator and a house of reps member
cases.truth: s.65(1): Senate 35, House of Representatives 30.

cases.q: how many senators does each state have
cases.truth: s.48: three per state, one for the FCT; s.49 House 360.

cases.q: how many members are in the house of representatives
cases.truth: s.49: 360 members.

cases.q: can a Nigerian have dual citizenship
cases.truth: s.28: acquiring another citizenship does not deprive a Nigerian citizen; (2) other-country citizens by registration/naturalisation lose it on acquiring another citizenship.

cases.q: if i was born in Nigeria to foreign parents am i a citizen
cases.truth: s.25(1): by birth requires parent or grandparent belonging to an indigenous community; birth in Nigeria alone is not enough.

cases.q: how do I become a Nigerian citizen by marriage
cases.truth: s.26(2)(a): woman married to a Nigerian citizen may apply for registration; (not husband).

cases.q: is freedom of speech guaranteed and can the government limit it
cases.truth: s.39 expression; s.45 derogation for defence, public safety, order, morality, health, rights of others.

cases.q: can the government take my land
cases.truth: s.44: compulsory acquisition only by law, with prompt payment of compensation and right of access to court.

cases.q: is it legal to be fired because of my tribe or religion
cases.truth: s.42 prohibits discrimination by government laws/practices by ethnic group, place of origin, sex, religion, status; employment law proper is outside the Constitution.

cases.q: who can remove a president from office
cases.truth: s.143 impeachment (gross misconduct; one-third notice; panel; two-thirds of each house); s.144 incapacity.

cases.q: can a governor be taken to court while in office
cases.truth: s.308: no civil or criminal proceedings against a governor/president in office; not applicable to impeachment-related process.

cases.q: how can the constitution be amended
cases.truth: s.9(2)-(3): two-thirds of each house of NASS and approval by at least 24 state Houses of Assembly (two-thirds of states).

cases.q: what does the constitution say about religion
cases.truth: s.10 no state religion; s.38 freedom of thought, conscience and religion.

cases.q: can i be tried twice for the same crime
cases.truth: s.36(9): no retrial after acquittal/conviction; ACJA s.238.

cases.q: am i presumed innocent until proven guilty
do i have a right to a lawyer of my choice
cases.truth: s.35(2) consult lawyer; s.36(6)(c) legal practitioner of own choice.

cases.q: can the police arrest me for someone else's crime like my brother
cases.truth: ACJA s.7 and Police Act s.36: arrest in lieu of a suspect is prohibited.

cases.q: when can police use handcuffs
cases.truth: ACJA s.5 / Police Act s.34: no unnecessary restraint; handcuffs only where necessary (violence/escape risk) and justified.

cases.q: can the police torture a suspect to confess
cases.truth: s.34(1)(a) torture/inhuman treatment prohibited; ACJA s.8; Police Act s.37.

cases.q: what are the rules for police stop and search
cases.truth: Police Act ss.48-51: reasonable suspicion, identification, explanation, conduct.

cases.q: how do I report a police officer who harassed me
cases.truth: Police Complaints Response Unit ss.131-134.

cases.q: is bail a right in Nigeria
cases.truth: ACJA s.158 general entitlement to bail; s.161 capital offences; Police Act s.62.

cases.q: can someone accused of murder get bail
cases.truth: ACJA s.161: capital offence bail only in exceptional circumstances, on application to a High Court.

cases.q: what is plea bargain and how does it work
cases.truth: ACJA s.270.

cases.q: how long can a court remand someone in prison
cases.truth: ACJA s.296: remand order not exceeding 14 days, renewable once for 14 days; then further as the court directs.

cases.q: can a suspect be given compensation if wrongfully arrested
cases.truth: s.35(6): compensation and public apology for unlawful arrest/detention; ACJA s.314 compensation to victim in judgment.

cases.q: can a child be sentenced to death
cases.truth: ACJA s.405: no sentence of death on a person under 18 at the time of offence.

cases.q: can a pregnant woman be executed
cases.truth: ACJA s.404: sentence of death not passed on a pregnant woman; imprisonment for life instead.

cases.q: who appoints the inspector general of police and for how long
cases.truth: s.215 Constitution: President on advice of Nigeria Police Council; Police Act s.7 tenure.

cases.q: can the governor give orders to the state police commissioner
cases.truth: s.215(4): Governor may give lawful directions, but Commissioner may refer to the President/IGP if the directions are unlawful or inconsistent.

cases.q: can a state have its own police force
cases.truth: s.214(1): there shall be a Police Force for Nigeria, and no other police force shall be established for the Federation or any part.

cases.q: what is community policing in nigeria
cases.truth: Police Act ss.113-119 Community Policing Committees.

cases.q: what is the retirement age for judges
cases.truth: s.291: 65 for most judges; 70 for Supreme Court and Court of Appeal (and certain others); verify text.

cases.q: what powers does the national assembly have to investigate
cases.truth: ss.88-89 investigative powers and summoning.

cases.q: what happens if the president refuses to sign a bill
cases.truth: s.58(4) 30 days; s.59 override by two-thirds of each house.

cases.q: what are the duties of a citizen
can the government declare a state of emergency
cases.truth: s.305 President may proclaim a state of emergency in listed circumstances; NASS approval within set days.

cases.q: what is federal character
who owns minerals and oil found in the land
cases.truth: s.44(3): entire property in and control of minerals, mineral oils and natural gas vests in the Government of the Federation.

cases.q: how are election disputes for president handled
cases.truth: s.239 Court of Appeal original jurisdiction for presidential election petitions; s.285 timelines (21 days to file, 180 days tribunal).

cases.q: where do I go to enforce my fundamental rights
cases.truth: s.46: High Court of the State (or Federal High Court).

cases.q: what is the supreme court's original jurisdiction
cases.truth: s.232: disputes between the Federation and a state or between states.

cases.q: who can be vice president and what is a running mate
cases.truth: s.142: running mate on same ticket; must meet same qualifications.

cases.q: can i be forced to join a political party or union
cases.truth: s.40: right to assemble and associate; no one may be compelled to join a political party/association (see text).

cases.q: police came to my house at 3am with no warrant and took my laptop, was this legal
cases.truth: Search needs warrant unless exceptions; s.37 privacy of homes. Time limits of search warrants ACJA s.148.

cases.q: my landlord threw out my stuff and locked me out, does the constitution help me
cases.truth: Property rights mostly apply against State; tenancy law outside corpus; should say so.

cases.q: i was arrested on friday evening and the police say i must stay till monday, is that allowed
cases.truth: s.35(4): must be brought before court within 24/48h; Police Act s.62 bail for arrested without warrant.

cases.q: police arrested my wife instead of me because they could not find me
cases.truth: Arrest in lieu prohibited.

cases.q: a police officer asked me for my ID at a checkpoint and then searched my bag, must I allow it
cases.truth: s.49 stop and search with reasonable suspicion; s.50 identify and give grounds.

cases.q: a private security guard held me for stealing and wants to beat a confession out of me
cases.truth: Private person arrest must hand over to police promptly; torture prohibited.

cases.q: I'm 16 and was arrested for robbery, can I be tried like an adult
cases.truth: ACJA child offender provisions; Child's Rights Act (not in corpus) governs; should flag limit.

cases.q: the judge adjourned my case 15 times, is there a limit
cases.truth: ACJA s.396 day-to-day trial; limits on adjournments (check text).

cases.q: i was detained for 6 months without charge
cases.truth: s.35(4); ACJA s.32 and Police Act s.64 remedy of suspect detained.

cases.q: the police refuse to give me bail for a simple offence, what can I do
cases.truth: Police bail provisions.

cases.q: state governor sacked the local government chairmen, is that constitutional
cases.truth: s.7: democratically elected local government councils guaranteed; state laws cannot dissolve them.

cases.q: president signed a treaty, does it automatically become law in Nigeria
cases.truth: s.12: no treaty has force of law until enacted by National Assembly.

cases.q: a state law contradicts the constitution, which one wins
cases.truth: s.1(3): inconsistent law void to the extent of inconsistency.

cases.q: can the military take over government
cases.truth: s.1(2): no person or group shall take control of the Government except in accordance with the Constitution.

cases.q: my employer made me work without pay for months, which constitutional right applies
cases.truth: s.34(1)(c) forced labour; s.17(3) objectives; labour law outside corpus.

cases.q: the news station was shut down by the government for criticising the president
cases.truth: s.39(1),(2)-(3); s.22 role of mass media; s.45.

cases.q: can a Muslim woman be barred from wearing hijab in school under the constitution
cases.truth: s.38 manifest religion; no express hijab provision; should not invent.

cases.q: someone sued me but I was never served the court papers
cases.truth: s.36 fair hearing; civil service rules outside corpus.

cases.q: the constitution says police can detain me for 72 hours right?
cases.truth: False premise: 24h/48h, not 72 hours.

cases.q: is it true that a president can serve three terms if the second was short
cases.truth: s.137(3): no; oath for completing another's term counts as one term; max two terms.

cases.q: what does section 420 of the constitution say
cases.truth: Constitution has 320 sections; no section 420.

cases.q: what does section 168 say
cases.truth: s.168 is missing from the stored edition; should disclose rather than invent.

cases.q: does the constitution allow same sex marriage
cases.truth: Not addressed in corpus; must not invent; Same Sex Marriage (Prohibition) Act is outside corpus.

cases.q: what is the penalty for armed robbery in Nigeria
cases.truth: Penalty is in Robbery and Firearms Act, outside corpus.

cases.q: how much is VAT in Nigeria
cases.truth: Outside corpus.

cases.q: can I divorce my husband without going to court
cases.truth: Marriage law outside corpus.

cases.q: Is the 1999 constitution the current law or was it replaced
cases.truth: Corpus holds historical/source edition; must caveat that amendments exist.

cases.q: wat does secton 37 say abt privcy
arrest wiyhout warant by polise
cases.truth: Police Act s.38; ACJA s.18.

cases.q: presidnet tenur lenght
wetin constitution talk about police checking my phone
cases.truth: s.37 privacy; no phone-specific rule.

cases.q: police don arrest me, how long dem fit hold me
cases.truth: 24/48 hours.

cases.q: person fit sue governor when e dey office
how many years president fit rule
cases.truth: 4 years, two terms.

cases.q: section thirty something about privacy
freedom
cases.truth: Ambiguous; should offer rights options.

cases.q: the one about police
cases.truth: Should ask to clarify or show ss.214-216.

cases.q: Section 35(4) of the Constitution
ACJA section 158
cases.truth: ACJA s.158.

cases.q: Police Act 2020 section 35
cases.truth: Police Act s.35.

cases.q: compare the constitution and the police act on how long a suspect can be held
cases.truth: Both layers.

cases.q: what do the constitution and ACJA each say about arrest without warrant
cases.truth: Both layers.

cases.q: can the police break into my house to arrest someone
cases.truth: ACJA s.13 / Police Act s.45 power to break out of a house; s.12 entry to place.

cases.q: what must the police write down when they arrest someone
cases.truth: Recording of arrests.

cases.q: can the police record my statement without my lawyer
cases.truth: ACJA s.17 / Police Act s.60: lawyer of choice present, audio-visual recording.

cases.q: can a police officer be punished for assaulting a suspect
cases.truth: s.96 offences by officer; humane treatment s.37.

cases.q: what are the penalties for pretending to be a police officer
can the police be sued for wrongful arrest
cases.truth: s.35(6) compensation; s.46 enforcement.

cases.q: what happens if a bail surety fails to produce the defendant
cases.truth: Forfeiture of recognizance ss.179-185.

cases.q: is the death penalty legal in nigeria
cases.truth: s.33(1) exception for execution of court sentence for criminal offence.
